backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a favorites list with add, remove, and query functions, storing title/URL pairs in a mutable list.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features—generating an Angel aesthetics image and replacing the Home page widget with it—to their associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for components, pages, data files, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Tailwind directives and defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Kitsch-io' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Query and a client-side router with routes for Home, Games, Movies, and Music pages under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/GameCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a game's title, category badge, description, and an external Play Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout shell rendering a fixed background layer, dark overlay, header with navigation links, a Style button for the personalization panel, and a mobile nav bar.
frontend/src/components/MovieCard.tsx: Reusable card component displaying a movie's title, year, genre badge, synopsis, and an external Watch Now link with Y2K black/silver styling.
frontend/src/components/PersonalizationP: Modal overlay panel that lets users choose from 9 background wallpapers and adjust overlay opacity, receiving personalization state via props.
frontend/src/components/ShowCard.tsx: Reusable card component for anime/drama shows displaying title, episode count, genre badge, description, and a Watch Now link with configurable accent color.
frontend/src/components/TrackCard.tsx: A React component that displays a music track card with title, artist, genre badge, an HTML audio player, and an optional source link.
frontend/src/components/widgets/ClockWid: A widget component that shows a live-updating digital clock with hours, minutes, seconds, and the current date, updating every second via an interval.
frontend/src/components/widgets/Favorite: A widget that displays a user's saved favorite links fetched via React Query hooks, with the ability to add new favorites or remove existing ones.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MoodBoar: A widget that lets users select and persist a current mood (emoji + label) from a predefined list, storing the selection in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/widgets/MusicTic: A static widget that displays a horizontally scrolling ticker of hardcoded classical music track names with a CSS animation.
frontend/src/data/anime.ts: Exports a typed array of anime show objects (title, episodes, genre, description, watchUrl) covering classic and older anime series with Archive.org links.
frontend/src/data/c-drama.ts: Exports a typed array of Chinese drama show objects with metadata and Viki watch URLs, covering historical, fantasy, and wuxia genres.
frontend/src/data/games.ts: Exports a typed array of classic/retro games with category, description, and Archive.org URLs, spanning action, platformer, shooter, and other DOS/NES genres.
frontend/src/data/j-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Japanese drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and Viki watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/k-drama.ts: Defines a Show interface and exports an array of Korean drama shows with title, episode count, genre, description, and watch URLs across Viki, Netflix, and Kocowa.
frontend/src/data/movies.ts: Defines a Movie interface and exports a large array of movies spanning multiple eras, each with title, year, genre, synopsis, and Internet Archive watch URLs.
frontend/src/data/music.ts: Defines a Track interface and exports an array of public domain classical and orchestral music tracks with artist, genre, and Internet Archive audio/source URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChat.ts: Custom React hook managing chat state for an AI assistant named Kitschy, handling message history, sending messages via an AI service, loading state, and error handling with a clearHistory utility.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/usePersonalization.ts: Hook that manages user background texture and overlay opacity preferences, persisting settings to localStorage and providing URL mappings for each texture option.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and removing user favorites via a canister actor, with automatic cache invalidation on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Google Fonts, defines CSS custom properties for a dark theme color system, and styles scrollbars and audio elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AIAssistant.tsx: Chat UI page featuring a Kitschy AI assistant with message bubbles, a loading indicator, and a textarea input that sends messages via the useChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Anime.tsx: Anime browsing page that renders a filterable, searchable grid of anime shows using genre select and text search inputs against a static data source.
frontend/src/pages/CDrama.tsx: C-Drama browsing page that renders a filterable, searchable grid of Chinese drama shows with genre and text search controls against a static data source.
frontend/src/pages/Games.tsx: Displays a searchable, filterable grid of 20 browser-based games (puzzles, arcade, strategy, etc.) using category tabs and a text search input, rendering each game via a GameCard component.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page for KitschHub featuring a hero section, a decorative banner image, and three navigation cards linking to the Games, Movies, and Music sections.
frontend/src/pages/JDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Japanese drama series with text search and genre filter, rendering results from the jDramaShows data source using ShowCard components with an aqua accent.
frontend/src/pages/KDrama.tsx: Page for browsing Korean drama series with text search and genre filter, rendering results from the kDramaShows data source using ShowCard components with a hotpink accent.
frontend/src/pages/Movies.tsx: Displays a filterable grid of public domain/classic movies with search, genre, and decade filters, rendering each entry via a MovieCard component.
frontend/src/pages/Music.tsx: Music page listing public-domain tracks (classical, jazz, ragtime, etc.) from archive.org with search and genre filtering, rendering each track via a TrackCard component.
frontend/src/pages/Personalization.tsx: React page that lets users customize the site's background wallpaper by selecting from 9 predefined textures and adjusting overlay opacity, with settings persisted via the usePersonalization hook.
frontend/src/services/aiService.ts: Service that sends chat messages to the Mistral-7B model on Hugging Face Inference API and falls back to hardcoded keyword-based responses when the API call fails.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based semantic colors, Bebas Neue/Inter fonts, zero border-radius, silver glow shadows, and the animate/typography plugins.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a dark grunge aesthetics site; tracks two completed features — generating an 'Angel aesthetics' image asset and replacing a home page widget with that image.
